Paradise Resort replaced Champions Festival as the World Championships promo in 2023, the first Worlds held in Japan, at Pacifico Yokohama from 11 to 13 August 2023. Naoki Saito's art hides the traditional Psyduck upside down and shows Yokohama landmarks, the Landmark Tower and the Cosmo Clock 21 Ferris wheel. Competitors received the card, staff got a Staff copy, and the top finishers got copies stamped with their placement.

Paradise Resort, with new art by Naoki Saito, was the promo card of the 2024 Pokémon World Championships, held at the Hawai'i Convention Center in Honolulu from 16 to 18 August 2024. The art shows a surfing Pikachu with Alolan Raichu, Gholdengo, Lechonk, Mantine, Psyduck, Squawkabilly, Alolan Exeggutor, Palafin and Bruxish. Play! Pokémon revealed it during the 2024 North America International Championships livestream as an item for qualified Worlds competitors while supplies lasted; staff got a Staff copy and the top finishers copies stamped with their placement.

Paradise Resort was the promo card of the 2025 Pokémon World Championships, held at the Anaheim Convention Center in California from 15 to 17 August 2025. Naoki Saito's art features Eevee, Cleffa, Munchlax, Morpeko, Maushold, Varoom, Haunter, Falinks, Flamigo, Alolan Exeggutor, Psyduck and Lickitung. Competitors received the card, staff got a Staff copy, and the top finishers got copies stamped with their placement.
